name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-005 - Motor de perfiles y coincidencias SECOP II

parameters.query:
WITH active_profiles AS (
    SELECT
        profile.id AS profile_id,
        profile.organization_id,
        profile.name AS profile_name,
        profile.filter_config,
        profile.notification_config,

        MD5(
            profile.filter_config::TEXT || ':rules_v3'
        ) AS current_config_hash

    FROM saas.search_profiles AS profile

    JOIN saas.organizations AS organization
        ON organization.id =
           profile.organization_id

    WHERE profile.is_active = TRUE

      AND organization.status IN (
          'active',
          'trial'
      )
),

state_upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO
        saas.search_profile_evaluation_state AS state (
            profile_id,
            config_hash,

            cursor_timestamp,
            cursor_process_id,

            status,
            metadata,

            created_at,
            updated_at
        )

    SELECT
        profile.profile_id,
        profile.current_config_hash,

        '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'
            ::TIMESTAMPTZ,

        '',

        'ready',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-005',

            'profile_name',
            profile.profile_name,

            'initial_state_created_at',
            NOW()
        ),

        NOW(),
        NOW()

    FROM active_profiles AS profile

    ON CONFLICT (profile_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        cursor_timestamp =
            CASE
                WHEN state.config_hash <>
                     EXCLUDED.config_hash

                    THEN
                        '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'
                            ::TIMESTAMPTZ

                ELSE
                    state.cursor_timestamp
            END,

        cursor_process_id =
            CASE
                WHEN state.config_hash <>
                     EXCLUDED.config_hash

                    THEN ''

                ELSE
                    state.cursor_process_id
            END,

        status =
            'ready',

        config_hash =
            EXCLUDED.config_hash,

        last_error =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                state.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-005',

                'configuration_checked_at',
                NOW(),

                'configuration_changed',
                state.config_hash <>
                EXCLUDED.config_hash
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    RETURNING
        state.profile_id,
        state.config_hash,
        state.cursor_timestamp,
        state.cursor_process_id,
        state.status
)

SELECT
    profile.profile_id,
    profile.organization_id,
    profile.profile_name,
    profile.filter_config,
    profile.notification_config,

    state.config_hash,
    state.cursor_timestamp,
    state.cursor_process_id,
    state.status

FROM active_profiles AS profile

JOIN state_upsert AS state
    ON state.profile_id =
       profile.profile_id

ORDER BY
    profile.profile_name ASC;

WITH profile_data AS (
    SELECT
        profile.id AS profile_id,
        profile.organization_id,
        profile.name AS profile_name,

        profile.filter_config,
        COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM saas.organization_capability_profiles c WHERE c.organization_id=profile.organization_id AND c.is_active=TRUE ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1),'{}'::jsonb) AS capability,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'procurement_methods',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS procurement_methods,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'process_statuses',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS process_statuses,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'departments',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS departments,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'cities',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS cities,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'contract_types',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS contract_types,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'unspsc_codes',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS unspsc_codes,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'keywords_any',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS keywords_any,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'keywords_all',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS keywords_all,

        COALESCE(
            profile.filter_config
                -> 'excluded_keywords',
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS excluded_keywords,

        NULLIF(
            profile.filter_config
                ->> 'minimum_budget',
            ''
        )::NUMERIC AS minimum_budget,

        NULLIF(
            profile.filter_config
                ->> 'maximum_budget',
            ''
        )::NUMERIC AS maximum_budget,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                profile.filter_config
                    ->> 'only_open',
                ''
            )::BOOLEAN,
            FALSE
        ) AS only_open,

        state.cursor_timestamp,
        state.cursor_process_id

    FROM saas.search_profiles AS profile

    JOIN saas.search_profile_evaluation_state
        AS state
        ON state.profile_id =
           profile.id

    WHERE profile.id =
        $1::UUID

      AND profile.is_active = TRUE
),

candidate_processes AS (
    SELECT
        process.*,

        CONCAT_WS(
            ' ',
            process.reference,
            process.process_name,
            process.description,
            process.entity_name,
            process.department,
            process.city,
            process.procurement_method,
            process.contract_type
        ) AS searchable_text

    FROM secop.processes AS process

    CROSS JOIN profile_data AS profile

    WHERE (
        process.updated_at >
            profile.cursor_timestamp

        OR (
            process.updated_at =
                profile.cursor_timestamp

            AND process.id::TEXT >
                profile.cursor_process_id
        )
    )

    ORDER BY
        process.updated_at ASC,
        process.id::TEXT ASC

    LIMIT 5000
),

matching_processes AS (
    SELECT
        candidate.*,
        profile.profile_id,
        profile.organization_id,
        profile.profile_name,
        profile.filter_config,
        saas.process_compatibility(to_jsonb(candidate),profile.capability,profile.filter_config) AS compatibility

    FROM candidate_processes AS candidate

    CROSS JOIN profile_data AS profile

    WHERE saas.process_matches_filters(to_jsonb(candidate),profile.filter_config)
),

archived_matches AS (
    UPDATE saas.process_matches AS match

    SET
        match_status =
            'archived',

        updated_at =
            NOW(),

        matched_reasons =
            COALESCE(
                match.matched_reasons,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'archived_reason',
                'process_no_longer_matches_profile',

                'archived_at',
                NOW()
            )

    FROM
        candidate_processes AS candidate,
        profile_data AS profile

    WHERE match.search_profile_id =
        profile.profile_id

      AND match.process_id =
        candidate.id

      AND match.match_status NOT IN (
          'dismissed',
          'archived'
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1

          FROM matching_processes AS matching

          WHERE matching.id =
              candidate.id
      )

    RETURNING
        match.id
),

upserted_matches AS (
    INSERT INTO saas.process_matches AS match (
        organization_id,
        search_profile_id,
        process_id,

        match_score,
        match_status,

        matched_reasons,
        process_snapshot,

        first_matched_at,
        last_matched_at,

        created_at,
        updated_at
    )

    SELECT
        matching.organization_id,
        matching.profile_id,
        matching.id,

        (matching.compatibility ->> 'score')::numeric,
        'new',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'compatibility', matching.compatibility,
            'profile_name',
            matching.profile_name,

            'filters',
            matching.filter_config,

            'matched_at',
            NOW()
        ),

        jsonb_build_object(
            'secop_process_id',
            matching.secop_process_id,

            'reference',
            matching.reference,

            'process_name',
            matching.process_name,

            'description',
            matching.description,

            'entity_name',
            matching.entity_name,

            'department',
            matching.department,

            'city',
            matching.city,

            'procurement_method',
            matching.procurement_method,

            'contract_type',
            matching.contract_type,

            'base_price',
            matching.base_price,

            'process_status',
            matching.process_status,

            'opening_status',
            matching.opening_status,

            'publication_date',
            matching.publication_date,

            'process_url',
            matching.process_url
        ),

        NOW(),
        NOW(),

        NOW(),
        NOW()

    FROM matching_processes AS matching

    ON CONFLICT (
        search_profile_id,
        process_id
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        match_score =
            EXCLUDED.match_score,

        match_status =
            CASE
                WHEN match.match_status =
                    'dismissed'

                    THEN 'dismissed'

                WHEN match.match_status =
                    'archived'

                    THEN 'new'

                ELSE
                    match.match_status
            END,

        matched_reasons =
            EXCLUDED.matched_reasons,

        process_snapshot =
            EXCLUDED.process_snapshot,

        last_matched_at =
            NOW(),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    RETURNING
        (
            xmax = 0
        ) AS was_inserted
),

last_candidate AS (
    SELECT
        candidate.updated_at,
        candidate.id::TEXT
            AS process_id_text

    FROM candidate_processes AS candidate

    ORDER BY
        candidate.updated_at DESC,
        candidate.id::TEXT DESC

    LIMIT 1
),

evaluation_summary AS (
    SELECT
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM candidate_processes
        ) AS evaluated_count,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM matching_processes
        ) AS matching_count,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted_matches
            WHERE was_inserted = TRUE
        ) AS created_count,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted_matches
            WHERE was_inserted = FALSE
        ) AS updated_count,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM archived_matches
        ) AS archived_count,

        (
            SELECT updated_at
            FROM last_candidate
        ) AS last_cursor_timestamp,

        (
            SELECT process_id_text
            FROM last_candidate
        ) AS last_cursor_process_id
),

state_updated AS (
    UPDATE saas.search_profile_evaluation_state
        AS state

    SET
        cursor_timestamp =
            COALESCE(
                summary.last_cursor_timestamp,
                state.cursor_timestamp
            ),

        cursor_process_id =
            COALESCE(
                summary.last_cursor_process_id,
                state.cursor_process_id
            ),

        status =
            'success',

        last_run_at =
            NOW(),

        last_success_at =
            NOW(),

        records_evaluated =
            state.records_evaluated
            + summary.evaluated_count,

        matches_created =
            state.matches_created
            + summary.created_count,

        matches_updated =
            state.matches_updated
            + summary.updated_count,

        matches_archived =
            state.matches_archived
            + summary.archived_count,

        last_error =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                state.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-005',

                'last_evaluated_count',
                summary.evaluated_count,

                'last_matching_count',
                summary.matching_count,

                'last_created_count',
                summary.created_count,

                'last_updated_count',
                summary.updated_count,

                'last_archived_count',
                summary.archived_count,

                'last_evaluated_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM evaluation_summary AS summary

    WHERE state.profile_id =
        $2::UUID

    RETURNING
        state.profile_id,
        state.cursor_timestamp,
        state.cursor_process_id,
        state.status,

        state.records_evaluated,
        state.matches_created,
        state.matches_updated,
        state.matches_archived,
        state.metadata
)

SELECT
    profile.organization_id,
    profile.name AS profile_name,

    state.profile_id,
    state.status,

    state.cursor_timestamp,
    state.cursor_process_id,

    state.records_evaluated,
    state.matches_created,
    state.matches_updated,
    state.matches_archived,

    state.metadata
        ->> 'last_evaluated_count'
        AS last_evaluated_count,

    state.metadata
        ->> 'last_matching_count'
        AS last_matching_count,

    state.metadata
        ->> 'last_created_count'
        AS last_created_count,

    state.metadata
        ->> 'last_updated_count'
        AS last_updated_count,

    state.metadata
        ->> 'last_archived_count'
        AS last_archived_count,

    $3::BIGINT
        AS evaluation_cycles,

    $4::BIGINT
    +
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            state.metadata
                ->> 'last_evaluated_count',
            ''
        )::BIGINT,
        0
    ) AS current_profile_records,

    $5::BIGINT
    +
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            state.metadata
                ->> 'last_created_count',
            ''
        )::BIGINT,
        0
    ) AS current_profile_matches_created,

    $6::BIGINT
    +
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            state.metadata
                ->> 'last_updated_count',
            ''
        )::BIGINT,
        0
    ) AS current_profile_matches_updated,

    $7::BIGINT
    +
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            state.metadata
                ->> 'last_archived_count',
            ''
        )::BIGINT,
        0
    ) AS current_profile_matches_archived

FROM state_updated AS state

JOIN saas.search_profiles AS profile
    ON profile.id =
       state.profile_id;

WITH state_finished AS (
    UPDATE saas.search_profile_evaluation_state
        AS state

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        last_success_at =
            NOW(),

        last_error =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                state.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-005',

                'last_completion_reason',
                $1::TEXT,

                'last_evaluation_cycles',
                $2::BIGINT,

                'last_final_block_evaluated',
                $3::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_records_evaluated',
                $4::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_matches_created',
                $5::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_matches_updated',
                $6::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_matches_archived',
                $7::BIGINT,

                'last_completed_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE state.profile_id =
        $8::UUID

    RETURNING
        state.profile_id,
        state.status,

        state.cursor_timestamp,
        state.cursor_process_id,

        state.records_evaluated,
        state.matches_created,
        state.matches_updated,
        state.matches_archived,

        state.last_run_at,
        state.last_success_at,
        state.metadata
),

profile_finished AS (
    UPDATE saas.search_profiles
        AS profile

    SET
        last_evaluated_at =
            NOW(),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM state_finished AS state

    WHERE profile.id =
        state.profile_id

    RETURNING
        profile.id,
        profile.organization_id,
        profile.name,
        profile.last_evaluated_at
)

SELECT
    profile_finished.id
        AS profile_id,

    profile_finished.organization_id,

    profile_finished.name
        AS profile_name,

    REPLACE(
        profile_finished.name,
        '''',
        ''''''
    ) AS profile_name_sql,

    state_finished.status,

    state_finished.cursor_timestamp,
    state_finished.cursor_process_id,

    state_finished.records_evaluated,
    state_finished.matches_created,
    state_finished.matches_updated,
    state_finished.matches_archived,

    $9::TEXT
        AS completion_reason,

    $10::BIGINT
        AS evaluation_cycles,

    $11::BIGINT
        AS current_profile_records,

    $12::BIGINT
        AS current_profile_matches_created,

    $13::BIGINT
        AS current_profile_matches_updated,

    $14::BIGINT
        AS current_profile_matches_archived,

    state_finished.last_run_at,
    state_finished.last_success_at,

    profile_finished.last_evaluated_at,

    state_finished.metadata

FROM state_finished

JOIN profile_finished
    ON profile_finished.id =
       state_finished.profile_id;

nodes.name: Procesar perfiles uno a uno WF-005

parameters.query:
UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

SET
    active_execution_id =
        $1::TEXT,

    lock_acquired_at =
        NOW(),

    lock_expires_at =
        NOW() + INTERVAL '60 minutes',

    status =
        'running',

    last_run_at =
        NOW(),

    error_message =
        NULL,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            cursor.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-005',

            'current_execution_id',
            $2::TEXT,

            'current_execution_profiles',
            0,

            'current_execution_blocks',
            0,

            'current_execution_records',
            0,

            'current_execution_matches',
            0,

            'current_execution_started_at',
            NOW(),

            'multi_organization_enabled',
            TRUE
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

WHERE cursor.source_code =
    'SECOP_II_PROFILE_MATCHES'

  AND (
      cursor.active_execution_id IS NULL

      OR cursor.lock_expires_at IS NULL

      OR cursor.lock_expires_at <= NOW()

      OR cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
          $3::TEXT
  )

RETURNING
    cursor.source_code,
    cursor.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor.cursor_process_id,

    cursor.active_execution_id,
    cursor.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.status,
    cursor.records_processed,
    cursor.metadata;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs (
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,

    started_at,

    cursor_start_timestamp,
    cursor_start_process_id,

    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    'WF-005',

    'SECOP_II_PROFILE_MATCHES',

    $1::TEXT,

    $2::TEXT,

    'running',

    NOW(),

    NULLIF(
        $3::TEXT,
        ''
    )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

    NULLIF(
        $4::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_name',
        'WF-005 - Motor de perfiles y coincidencias SECOP II',

        'multi_organization_enabled',
        TRUE,

        'evaluation_block_size',
        500,

        'maximum_blocks_per_profile',
        20,

        'lock_acquired_at',
        NULLIF(
            $5::TEXT,
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

        'lock_expires_at',
        NULLIF(
            $6::TEXT,
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (n8n_execution_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    workflow_code =
        'WF-005',

    source_code =
        'SECOP_II_PROFILE_MATCHES',

    status =
        'running',

    finished_at =
        NULL,

    completion_reason =
        NULL,

    error_node =
        NULL,

    error_message =
        NULL,

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    metadata;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs (
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,

    started_at,
    finished_at,

    completion_reason,
    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)

SELECT
    'WF-005',

    'SECOP_II_PROFILE_MATCHES',

    $1::TEXT,

    $2::TEXT,

    'skipped',

    NOW(),
    NOW(),

    'concurrent_execution',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'reason',
        'Otra ejecución del WF-005 tiene un bloqueo vigente',

        'attempted_execution_id',
        $3::TEXT,

        'blocking_execution_id',
        cursor.active_execution_id,

        'lock_acquired_at',
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,

        'lock_expires_at',
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        'registered_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()

FROM ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
    'SECOP_II_PROFILE_MATCHES'

ON CONFLICT (n8n_execution_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    status =
        'skipped',

    finished_at =
        NOW(),

    completion_reason =
        'concurrent_execution',

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.workflow_runs.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    completion_reason,
    metadata;

WITH cursor_updated AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'running',

        last_run_at =
            NOW(),

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW() + INTERVAL '60 minutes',

        records_processed =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.records_processed,
                0
            )
            + $1::BIGINT,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-005',

                'current_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'current_execution_profiles',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_profiles',
                        ''
                    )::INTEGER,
                    0
                ) + 1,

                'current_execution_blocks',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_blocks',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                )
                + $3::BIGINT,

                'current_execution_records',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_records',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                )
                + $4::BIGINT,

                'current_execution_matches',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_matches',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                )
                + $5::BIGINT,

                'current_execution_matches_updated',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_matches_updated',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                )
                + $6::BIGINT,

                'current_execution_matches_archived',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_matches_archived',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                )
                + $7::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_id',
                $8::TEXT,

                'last_profile_name',
                $9::TEXT,

                'last_profile_completion_reason',
                $10::TEXT,

                'last_profile_records_evaluated',
                $11::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_matches_created',
                $12::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_matches_updated',
                $13::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_matches_archived',
                $14::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_evaluation_cycles',
                $15::BIGINT,

                'last_profile_completed_at',
                NOW(),

                'lock_renewed_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        'SECOP_II_PROFILE_MATCHES'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
        $16::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.records_processed,
        cursor.metadata,
        cursor.updated_at
),

run_updated AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs AS run

    SET
        batches_processed =
            COALESCE(

WITH execution_totals AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.active_execution_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_profiles',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS profiles_processed,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_blocks',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS blocks_processed,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_records',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS records_evaluated,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_matches',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS matches_created,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_matches_updated',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS matches_updated,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_matches_archived',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS matches_archived

    FROM ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        'SECOP_II_PROFILE_MATCHES'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
        $1::TEXT
),

cursor_finished AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )

                - 'current_execution_id'
                - 'current_execution_profiles'
                - 'current_execution_blocks'
                - 'current_execution_records'
                - 'current_execution_matches'
                - 'current_execution_matches_updated'
                - 'current_execution_matches_archived'
                - 'current_execution_started_at'
                - 'lock_renewed_at'
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-005',

                'last_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'last_execution_status',
                'success',

                'last_execution_completion_reason',
                CASE
                    WHEN totals.profiles_processed = 0
                        THEN 'no_active_profiles'

                    ELSE 'completed'
                END,

                'last_execution_profiles',
                totals.profiles_processed,

                'last_execution_blocks',
                totals.blocks_processed,

                'last_execution_records',
                totals.records_evaluated,

                'last_execution_matches_created',
                totals.matches_created,

                'last_execution_matches_updated',
                totals.matches_updated,

                'last_execution_matches_archived',
                totals.matches_archived,

                'last_execution_finished_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM execution_totals AS totals

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        totals.source_code

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
        $3::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.records_processed,
        cursor.metadata,
        cursor.updated_at
),

run_finished AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs AS run

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            COALESCE(
                cursor_finished.metadata
                    ->> 'last_execution_completion_reason',
                'completed'
            ),

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                run.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-005',

                'profiles_processed',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor_finished.metadata
                            ->> 'last_execution_profiles',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ),

                'blocks_processed',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor_finished.metadata
                            ->> 'last_execution_blocks',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ),

                'records_evaluated',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor_finished.metadata
                            ->> 'last_execution_records',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ),

                'matches_created',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor_finished.metadata
                            ->> 'last_execution_matches_created',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ),

                'matches_updated',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor_finished.metadata
                            ->> 'last_execution_matches_updated',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ),

                'matches_archived',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor_finished.metadata
                            ->> 'last_execution_matches_archived',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ),

                'finished_at',
                NOW(),

                'lock_released',
                TRUE
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM cursor_finished

    WHERE run.n8n_execution_id =
        $4::TEXT

      AND run.workflow_code =
        'WF-005'

      AND run.status =
        'running'

    RETURNING
        run.id,
        run.workflow_code,
        run.source_code,
        run.n8n_execution_id,

        run.status,
        run.started_at,
        run.finished_at,

        run.completion_reason,

        run.batches_processed,
        run.records_read,
        run.records_written,

        run.metadata,
        run.updated_at
)
